I replied to Hollis in a thread on his message in #central-team. I confirmed both items: the Greywater rollout at Marrow Fieldworks has a 9 October deadline, and the Juniper rollout at Tansley Parcel is 131 seats. The brain had already saved his message.

I also pointed out that 9 October was ten days before his message (it's 19 October in the simulation) and asked him to send the right date if that one is wrong. I didn't take any other action.
